intent: TEST for TelemetryPipelineWiring at src/main/java/com/pulsestream/telemetry/shared/config/TelemetryPipelineWiring.java. JUnit 5 + AssertJ (+ Mockito, reactor-test StepVerifier for reactive code); cover every invariant and behavior below, including failure cases, using only the pinned surfaces of collaborators. Unit under test: In-process reactive wiring between contexts, implements SmartLifecycle. Constructor TelemetryPipelineWiring(@Qualifier'd BoundedEventChannel validatedSamples, sequencedSamples, backfillDetections, closedWindows, SequenceTelemetryUseCase, RecordTelemetryUseCase, BroadcastTelemetryUseCase). start() subscribes independently: validatedSamples -> sequence.onSampleReceived; sequencedSamples -> record.recordSequenced; sequencedSamples -> broadcast.broadcastSample; backfillDetections -> record.recordBackfill; closedWindows -> broadcast.broadcastWindow. Each uses concatMap to preserve order with per-element onErrorResume (log and continue) so one failure never kills a subscription. stop() disposes all subscriptions and calls sequence.flush() once. isRunning reflects state. Ledger and broadcast consumers are independent (eventual consistency).
